features: Callback rm uses native callback lstat for its existing directory validation, then native callback rm for actual deletion. Error and success completion retain native request context and ownership.

Callback opendir performs eager stat validation through the native callback lane and preserves its error mapping. Dir.close(callback) queues callback delivery through nextTick so a thrown callback reaches uncaughtException rather than an internal promise rejection.
Node/Home controls and unchanged opendir concurrency/close/iteration process checks pass. The original rm validation case passes with exact name filtering; all native groups remain green.
limitations: Dir remains a lazy path-backed listing using a placeholder handle; real descriptor/stream identity, rename behavior, native iterator ownership and platform teardown remain #878. Passing ordinary opendir tests does not establish complete directory parity.

Node current Dir.read callback exception behavior differs from the initial assumption. Its failed reference control is retained, and read delivery was restored. Full pinned read receiver/exception semantics remain open; no claim of completed read exception parity.
